summary: Session #076 - Frontend forensic audit complete. Tested all 4 roles (admin, sales, manager, warehouse) across multiple pages. CONFIRMED: BUG #1 (dashboard cards leak to non-home pages) and BUG #2 (onboarding section leak). BUG #4 and #5 from backlog are NOT FOUND (already fixed). Sales role access restrictions working correctly. No white screens, crashes, or broken navigation found.

critical_bugs.title: Dashboard Cards Leaking to All Pages
critical_bugs.description: Dashboard summary cards (PRODUK AKTIF, AVAILABLE QTY, RESERVED QTY, ACTIVE ORDERS, GUDANG) are rendering on multiple pages instead of only on Beranda (home) page
critical_bugs.expected_behavior: Dashboard cards should ONLY appear on Beranda (home/dashboard) view
reproduction_steps: 1. Login as Manager or Warehouse role
2. Navigate to any page except Beranda (e.g., Analytics Hub, WMS Operations, Pusat Persetujuan)
3. Observe dashboard cards at top of page
critical_bugs.visual_evidence: Screenshots show cards with: PRODUK AKTIF: 11, AVAILABLE QTY: 3,715, RESERVED QTY: 220, ACTIVE ORDERS: 7-8, GUDANG: 3

critical_bugs.title: Onboarding Section Leaking to All Pages
critical_bugs.description: Role-specific onboarding checklist sections appear on multiple pages instead of only on home page or being dismissible
critical_bugs.expected_behavior: Onboarding checklist should only appear on first login, OR only on dedicated onboarding page, OR be dismissible and not reappear
